_note: Pilot sections use the official question counts and time limits. Knowledge sections use practice pacing; adjust them to match the current official study guide if you like.

subtests.name: Word Knowledge
subtests.tips: Break unfamiliar words into roots, prefixes and suffixes. If unsure, eliminate choices with the wrong tone (positive vs. negative).

subtests.name: Math Knowledge
subtests.tips: When solving takes too long, plug the answer choices back into the problem.

subtests.name: Arithmetic Reasoning
subtests.tips: Write down exactly what is being asked, then estimate to rule out impossible choices before calculating.

subtests.name: Verbal Analogies
subtests.tips: Make a short sentence linking the first pair ("a ___ is used by a ___"), then test that sentence on each choice.

subtests.name: Reading Comprehension
subtests.tips: Pick the answer the passage supports, not what you know from elsewhere.

subtests.name: Table Reading
subtests.tips: Slide along the top to the X column, then down to the Y row. Watch the signs: +4 and -4 are different columns.

subtests.name: Instrument Comprehension
subtests.tips: Read bank and pitch from the horizon line first, then the heading from the compass. Eliminate any choice that gets one part wrong.

subtests.name: Aviation Information
subtests.tips: Picture the three axes: ailerons roll, the elevator pitches, and the rudder yaws.

subtests.name: Block Counting
subtests.tips: Count blocks beside it in its layer, then every block it crosses in the layers directly above and below.

subtests.name: Ranks & Insignia
subtests.tips: Learn officer ranks in pairs: gold then silver bar, gold then silver oak leaf. For enlisted, count stripes up from Airman.

subtests.name: Heritage & Core Values
subtests.tips: Anchor dates to events: 1903 first flight, 1907 first Army air unit, 1947 independent Air Force, 2019 Space Force.

subtests.name: Aircraft
subtests.tips: Read the designation letters first: F fighter, B bomber, C cargo, K tanker, T trainer, Q unmanned.

subtests.name: Customs & Courtesies
subtests.tips: When in doubt, the junior member acts first: salutes first, gets in the car first, walks on the left.

subtests.name: Organization & AFROTC
subtests.tips: Picture the chain from the President down to your flight, and know the AFROTC terms: PAS, GMC, POC, LLAB.
